benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹7,000-8,000 Cr Indian premium pet care market.

calculationFlow: Indian pet dogs: ~2.5 crore (per generalist doc Q21); pet cats ~1 crore.
Of these, urban + Tier 2 with disposable income for pet care: ~50% = 1.25 crore HH.
Of these, spending on premium pet products: ~30% = ~37 lakh HH.
Average annual premium pet spend (food + grooming + accessories + vet): ~₹15,000-25,000.
Round: ~₹7,000-8,000 Cr Indian premium pet care market.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~₹7,000-8,000 Cr Indian premium pet care market.
